note: Nine immutable primary methods: K2 incumbent/static/conditional, K1 fixed43 incumbent/conditional, FP16, native4, base2 and explicitly named hybrid packed reference. Selection uses development and new-fit-select only; projection and query-rank metrics not advanced. Primary comparisons conditional versus same-rate incumbent; low-rate versus high-rate frontier. Both source pools remain answer-free at freeze.
scope: freeze of concrete methods, calibration inputs, analysis receipts and new source pools; does not establish novelty, superiority or backbone-pretraining exclusion
